rules.product: Every spoken motion (sit down, dance, come with me, wave, lie down, stand up, bow) must move the body — IntentFastPath → MotionClipMap → ClipAnimationLoader. A text-only reply is a UX failure.
rules.playback: node tools/qa/animation-audit.mjs --play writes per-avatar CSV and frame screenshots under tmp/animation-audit/

intentCoverage.why: posture; bubble yes with a standing body is a fail
clip-first; must play a shipped dance VRMA/BVH
follow path, not only a spoken acknowledgement
